def JFA.Theorem_1_1.{u} : (𝕜 : Type u) →
  [inst : RCLike 𝕜] →
    (E F X : Type u) →
      [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E] →
        [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] →
          [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] →
            [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] →
              [inst_5 : NormedAddCommGroup X] →
                [NormedSpace 𝕜 X] → [CompleteSpace E] → [CompleteSpace F] → [CompleteSpace X] → Prop :=
fun 𝕜 [RCLike 𝕜] E F X [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F]
    [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace 𝕜 X] [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F] [CompleteSpace X] =>
  TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace E →
    TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace F →
      ¬TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace X →
        JFA.HasFewOperators 𝕜 X →
          ∀ (α : JFA.UniformCrossnorm 𝕜) (A : Type u) [inst_10 : NormedAddCommGroup A] [inst_11 : NormedSpace 𝕜 A]
            [CompleteSpace A] (ι : TensorProduct 𝕜 E X →ₗ[𝕜] A),
            JFA.IsTensorCompletion 𝕜 E X A (α.normFor E X) ι →
              ∀ (T : A →L[𝕜] ↥(JFA.InjectiveTensor 𝕜 F X)),
                ∃! d,
                  JFA.HasSeparableRange 𝕜 A (↥(JFA.InjectiveTensor 𝕜 F X)) d.2 ∧
                    ∀ (e : E) (x : X), T (ι (e ⊗ₜ[𝕜] x)) = JFA.injectivePure 𝕜 F X (d.1 e) x + d.2 (ι (e ⊗ₜ[𝕜] x))
def JFA.Corollary_1_2.{u} : (𝕜 : Type u) →
  [inst : RCLike 𝕜] →
    (E F X : Type u) →
      [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E] →
        [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] →
          [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] →
            [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] →
              [inst_5 : NormedAddCommGroup X] →
                [NormedSpace 𝕜 X] → [CompleteSpace E] → [CompleteSpace F] → [CompleteSpace X] → Prop :=
fun 𝕜 [RCLike 𝕜] E F X [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F]
    [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace 𝕜 X] [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F] [CompleteSpace X] =>
  TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace E →
    TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace F →
      ¬TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace X →
        JFA.HasFewOperators 𝕜 X →
          (JFA.Isomorphic 𝕜 ↥(JFA.InjectiveTensor 𝕜 E X) ↥(JFA.InjectiveTensor 𝕜 F X) ↔ JFA.Isomorphic 𝕜 E F)
def JFA.Corollary_1_3.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} : (𝕜 : Type u_1) →
  [RCLike 𝕜] →
    (L : Type u_2) →
      [inst : TopologicalSpace L] →
        [LocallyCompactSpace L] →
          [T2Space L] →
            (M₁ : Type u_3) →
              (M₂ : Type u_4) →
                [inst : MetricSpace M₁] → [CompactSpace M₁] → [inst : MetricSpace M₂] → [CompactSpace M₂] → Prop :=
fun 𝕜 [RCLike 𝕜] L [TopologicalSpace L] [LocallyCompactSpace L] [T2Space L] M₁ M₂ [MetricSpace M₁] [CompactSpace M₁]
    [MetricSpace M₂] [CompactSpace M₂] =>
  ¬TopologicalSpace.MetrizableSpace L →
    JFA.HasFewOperators 𝕜 (L →C₀ 𝕜) →
      ∀ (T : ((M₁ × L) →C₀ 𝕜) →L[𝕜] (M₂ × L) →C₀ 𝕜),
        ∃! d,
          JFA.HasSeparableRange 𝕜 ((M₁ × L) →C₀ 𝕜) ((M₂ × L) →C₀ 𝕜) d.2 ∧
            ∀ (f : C(M₁, 𝕜)) (g : L →C₀ 𝕜) (h : (M₁ × L) →C₀ 𝕜),
              (∀ (p : M₁ × L), h p = f p.1 * g p.2) → ∀ (p : M₂ × L), (T h) p = (d.1 f) p.1 * g p.2 + (d.2 h) p
def JFA.Theorem_1_4.{u_1} : (𝕜 : Type u_1) → [RCLike 𝕜] → Set (Set ℕ) → Prop :=
fun 𝕜 [RCLike 𝕜] 𝒜 =>
  JFA.IsAlmostDisjoint 𝒜 →
    JFA.HasContinuumSize 𝒜 →
      JFA.HasFewOperators 𝕜 (JFA.MrowkaCZero 𝕜 𝒜) →
        ∀ (W : Submodule 𝕜 (JFA.AmplifiedMrowka 𝕜 𝒜)),
          JFA.IsComplemented 𝕜 (JFA.AmplifiedMrowka 𝕜 𝒜) W →
            ¬FiniteDimensional 𝕜 ↥W → ∃! c, JFA.IsModel 𝕜 (JFA.MrowkaCZero 𝕜 𝒜) (JFA.AmplifiedMrowka 𝕜 𝒜) (↥W) c
def JFA.Theorem_1_6.{u_1} : (𝕜 : Type u_1) → [RCLike 𝕜] → Set (Set ℕ) → Prop :=
fun 𝕜 [RCLike 𝕜] 𝒜 =>
  JFA.IsAlmostDisjoint 𝒜 →
    JFA.HasContinuumSize 𝒜 →
      JFA.HasFewOperators 𝕜 (JFA.MrowkaCZero 𝕜 𝒜) →
        let Y := JFA.AmplifiedMrowka 𝕜 𝒜;
        have I₀ := {0};
        have I₁ := JFA.compactOperators 𝕜 Y;
        have I₂ := JFA.factorizationOperators 𝕜 Y (JFA.cZero 𝕜);
        have I₃ := closure (JFA.factorizationOperators 𝕜 Y (JFA.MrowkaCZero 𝕜 𝒜));
        I₀ ⊂ I₁ ∧
          I₁ ⊂ I₂ ∧
            I₂ = JFA.separableOperators 𝕜 Y ∧
              I₂ ⊂ I₃ ∧
                I₃ ⊂ Set.univ ∧
                  ∀ (I : Set (Y →L[𝕜] Y)),
                    JFA.IsClosedOperatorIdeal 𝕜 Y I ↔ I = I₀ ∨ I = I₁ ∨ I = I₂ ∨ I = I₃ ∨ I = Set.univ

theorem JFA.amplified_decomposition.{u_1} : ∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} [inst : RCLike 𝕜] {𝒜 : Set (Set ℕ)}
  (h𝒜 : JFA.IsAlmostDisjoint 𝒜),
  JFA.HasContinuumSize 𝒜 →
    JFA.HasFewOperators 𝕜 (JFA.MrowkaCZero 𝕜 𝒜) →
      ∀ (T : JFA.AmplifiedMrowka 𝕜 𝒜 →L[𝕜] JFA.AmplifiedMrowka 𝕜 𝒜),
        ∃! d,
          JFA.HasSeparableRange 𝕜 (JFA.AmplifiedMrowka 𝕜 𝒜) (JFA.AmplifiedMrowka 𝕜 𝒜) d.2 ∧
            T = JFA.amplifiedTensorLift h𝒜 d.1 + d.2 :=
fun {𝕜} [RCLike 𝕜] {𝒜} h𝒜 hc hfew T =>
  let c := JFA.mrowkaAmplificationEquiv h𝒜;
  let U := JFA.amplifiedScalarOperator h𝒜 hc hfew T;
  let S := JFA.amplifiedRemainder h𝒜 hc hfew T;
  have hTS :=
    of_eq_true
      (Eq.trans
        (congrArg (Eq T) (add_sub_cancel (JFA.amplifiedTensorLift h𝒜 (JFA.amplifiedScalarOperator h𝒜 hc hfew T)) T))
        (eq_self T));
  Exists.intro (U, S)
    ⟨⟨JFA.amplifiedRemainder_separable h𝒜 hc hfew T, hTS⟩, fun y =>
      Prod.casesOn (motive := fun x =>
        (fun d =>
              JFA.HasSeparableRange 𝕜 (JFA.AmplifiedMrowka 𝕜 𝒜) (JFA.AmplifiedMrowka 𝕜 𝒜) d.2 ∧
                T = JFA.amplifiedTensorLift h𝒜 d.1 + d.2)
            x →
          x = (U, S))
        y fun V R a =>
        And.casesOn a fun hR hTR =>
          have hR' :=
            JFA.HasSeparableRange.comp_left
              (JFA.HasSeparableRange.comp_right hR ↑(JFA.mrowkaAmplificationEquiv h𝒜).toContinuousLinearEquiv)
              ↑(JFA.mrowkaAmplificationEquiv h𝒜).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv;
          have hV :=
            JFA.epsilonScalarOperator_of_decomposition (JFA.mrowka_czero_nonseparable h𝒜 hc) hfew
              (JFA.amplifiedConjugate h𝒜 T) V (JFA.amplifiedConjugate h𝒜 R) hR' fun f g =>
              have h :=
                congrArg (fun A => c.symm (A (c (JFA.injectivePure 𝕜 (JFA.cZero 𝕜) (JFA.MrowkaCZero 𝕜 𝒜) f g)))) hTR;
              id
                (Eq.mp
                  (congrArg
                    (Eq
                      ((JFA.mrowkaAmplificationEquiv h𝒜).symm
                        (T
                          ((JFA.mrowkaAmplificationEquiv h𝒜)
                            (JFA.injectivePure 𝕜 (JFA.cZero 𝕜) (JFA.MrowkaCZero 𝕜 𝒜) f g)))))
                    (Eq.trans
                      (Eq.trans
                        (congrArg
                          (fun x =>
                            (JFA.mrowkaAmplificationEquiv h𝒜).symm
                              (↑(JFA.mrowkaAmplificationEquiv h𝒜).toContinuousLinearEquiv
                                  ((JFA.injectiveTensorMap V) x) +
                                R
                                  ((JFA.mrowkaAmplificationEquiv h𝒜)
                                    (JFA.injectivePure 𝕜 (JFA.cZero 𝕜) (JFA.MrowkaCZero 𝕜 𝒜) f g))))
                          (LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_apply_apply (JFA.mrowkaAmplificationEquiv h𝒜)
                            (JFA.injectivePure 𝕜 (JFA.cZero 𝕜) (JFA.MrowkaCZero 𝕜 𝒜) f g)))
                        (map_add (JFA.mrowkaAmplificationEquiv h𝒜).symm
                          ((JFA.mrowkaAmplificationEquiv h𝒜)
                            (JFA.injectivePure 𝕜 (JFA.cZero 𝕜) (JFA.MrowkaCZero 𝕜 𝒜) (V f) g))
                          (R
                            ((JFA.mrowkaAmplificationEquiv h𝒜)
                              (JFA.injectivePure 𝕜 (JFA.cZero 𝕜) (JFA.MrowkaCZero 𝕜 𝒜) f g)))))
                      (congrArg
                        (fun x =>
                          x +
                            (JFA.mrowkaAmplificationEquiv h𝒜).symm
                              (R
                                ((JFA.mrowkaAmplificationEquiv h𝒜)
                                  (JFA.injectivePure 𝕜 (JFA.cZero 𝕜) (JFA.MrowkaCZero 𝕜 𝒜) f g))))
                        (LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_apply_apply (JFA.mrowkaAmplificationEquiv h𝒜)
                          (JFA.injectivePure 𝕜 (JFA.cZero 𝕜) (JFA.MrowkaCZero 𝕜 𝒜) (V f) g)))))
                  h);
          Prod.ext (Eq.symm hV)
            (add_left_cancel
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = JFA.amplifiedTensorLift h𝒜 V + (U, S).2) (Eq.symm hTR)))
                (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => T = JFA.amplifiedTensorLift h𝒜 _a + (U, S).2) (Eq.symm hV))) hTS)))⟩
theorem JFA.theorem_1_1.{u} : ∀ {𝕜 : Type u} [inst : RCLike 𝕜] {E F X : Type u} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : NormedSpace 𝕜 F] [inst_5 : CompleteSpace F]
  [inst_6 : NormedAddCommGroup X] [inst_7 : NormedSpace 𝕜 X] [inst_8 : CompleteSpace X] [inst_9 : CompleteSpace E],
  JFA.Theorem_1_1 𝕜 E F X :=
fun {𝕜} [RCLike 𝕜] {E F X} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F]
    [CompleteSpace F] [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace 𝕜 X] [CompleteSpace X] [CompleteSpace E] hE hF hX hfew α A
    [NormedAddCommGroup A] [NormedSpace 𝕜 A] [CompleteSpace A] ι hι T =>
  let p := α.normFor E X;
  let U := JFA.extractedOperator hX hfew p ι hι T;
  let S := JFA.tensorRemainder hX hfew p ι hι T;
  have hS := JFA.tensorRemainder_separable hX hfew p A ι hι T;
  have hEq := JFA.tensorRemainder_pure hX hfew p ι hι T;
  Exists.intro (U, S)
    ⟨⟨hS, hEq⟩, fun y =>
      Prod.casesOn (motive := fun x =>
        (fun d =>
              JFA.HasSeparableRange 𝕜 A (↥(JFA.InjectiveTensor 𝕜 F X)) d.2 ∧
                ∀ (e : E) (x : X), T (ι (e ⊗ₜ[𝕜] x)) = JFA.injectivePure 𝕜 F X (d.1 e) x + d.2 (ι (e ⊗ₜ[𝕜] x)))
            x →
          x = (U, S))
        y fun V R a =>
        And.casesOn a fun hR hV =>
          And.casesOn (JFA.tensor_decomposition_unique hX p ι hι T hS hR hEq hV) fun hUV hSR =>
            Prod.ext (Eq.symm hUV) (Eq.symm hSR)⟩
theorem JFA.corollary_1_2.{u} : ∀ {𝕜 : Type u} [inst : RCLike 𝕜] {E F X : Type u} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : NormedSpace 𝕜 F] [inst_5 : CompleteSpace F]
  [inst_6 : NormedAddCommGroup X] [inst_7 : NormedSpace 𝕜 X] [inst_8 : CompleteSpace X] [inst_9 : CompleteSpace E],
  JFA.Corollary_1_2 𝕜 E F X :=
fun {𝕜} [RCLike 𝕜] {E F X} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F]
    [CompleteSpace F] [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace 𝕜 X] [CompleteSpace X] [CompleteSpace E] hE hF hX hfew =>
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      Nonempty.casesOn a fun e =>
        let T := ↑e;
        let Q := ↑e.symm;
        let U := JFA.epsilonScalarOperator hX hfew T;
        let V := JFA.epsilonScalarOperator hX hfew Q;
        have hQT := ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun z => ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply e z;
        have hTQ := ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun z => ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply e z;
        have hVU :=
          Trans.trans
            (Trans.trans (Eq.symm (JFA.epsilonScalarOperator_comp hX hfew T Q))
              (congrArg (JFA.epsilonScalarOperator hX hfew) hQT))
            (JFA.epsilonScalarOperator_id hX hfew);
        have hUV :=
          Trans.trans
            (Trans.trans (Eq.symm (JFA.epsilonScalarOperator_comp hX hfew Q T))
              (congrArg (JFA.epsilonScalarOperator hX hfew) hTQ))
            (JFA.epsilonScalarOperator_id hX hfew);
        Nonempty.intro (ContinuousLinearEquiv.equivOfInverse' U V hUV hVU),
    mpr := fun a =>
      Nonempty.casesOn a fun e =>
        let U := ↑e;
        let V := ↑e.symm;
        have hVU := ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun z => ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply e z;
        have hUV := ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun z => ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply e z;
        have hTVU :=
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => _a = ContinuousLinearMap.id 𝕜 ↥(JFA.InjectiveTensor 𝕜 E X))
                (Eq.symm (JFA.injectiveTensorMap_comp U V))))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (fun _a => JFA.injectiveTensorMap _a = ContinuousLinearMap.id 𝕜 ↥(JFA.InjectiveTensor 𝕜 E X))
                  hVU))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => _a = ContinuousLinearMap.id 𝕜 ↥(JFA.InjectiveTensor 𝕜 E X))
                    JFA.injectiveTensorMap_id))
                (Eq.refl (ContinuousLinearMap.id 𝕜 ↥(JFA.InjectiveTensor 𝕜 E X)))));
        have hTUV :=
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => _a = ContinuousLinearMap.id 𝕜 ↥(JFA.InjectiveTensor 𝕜 F X))
                (Eq.symm (JFA.injectiveTensorMap_comp V U))))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (fun _a => JFA.injectiveTensorMap _a = ContinuousLinearMap.id 𝕜 ↥(JFA.InjectiveTensor 𝕜 F X))
                  hUV))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => _a = ContinuousLinearMap.id 𝕜 ↥(JFA.InjectiveTensor 𝕜 F X))
                    JFA.injectiveTensorMap_id))
                (Eq.refl (ContinuousLinearMap.id 𝕜 ↥(JFA.InjectiveTensor 𝕜 F X)))));
        Nonempty.intro
          (ContinuousLinearEquiv.equivOfInverse' (JFA.injectiveTensorMap U) (JFA.injectiveTensorMap V) hTUV hTVU) }
theorem JFA.corollary_1_3.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} : ∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} [inst : RCLike 𝕜] {L : Type u_2}

  JFA.Corollary_1_3 𝕜 L M₁ M₂ :=
fun {𝕜} [RCLike 𝕜] {L} [TopologicalSpace L] [LocallyCompactSpace L] [T2Space L] M₁ M₂ [MetricSpace M₁] [CompactSpace M₁]
    [MetricSpace M₂] [CompactSpace M₂] hL hfew T =>
  let E := C(M₁, 𝕜);
  let F := C(M₂, 𝕜);
  let X := L →C₀ 𝕜;
  let c₁ := JFA.czeroTensorEquiv;
  let c₂ := JFA.czeroTensorEquiv;
  let T' := (↑c₂.symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv).comp (T.comp ↑c₁.toContinuousLinearEquiv);
  have hX := JFA.czero_nonseparable_of_nonmetrizable hL;
  Exists.casesOn (JFA.epsilonDecomposition hX hfew T') fun d h =>
    And.casesOn h fun left hunique =>
      And.casesOn left fun hsep hEq =>
        let S := (↑c₂.toContinuousLinearEquiv).comp (d.2.comp ↑c₁.symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv);
        have hS :=
          JFA.HasSeparableRange.comp_left (JFA.HasSeparableRange.comp_right hsep ↑c₁.symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv)
            ↑c₂.toContinuousLinearEquiv;
        have hproduct := fun f g =>
          have h := congrArg (⇑c₂) (hEq f g);
          id
            (fun h =>
              id
                (Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg
                      (fun x =>
                        T (c₁ (JFA.injectivePure 𝕜 E X f g)) = c₂ (JFA.injectivePure 𝕜 F X (d.1 f) g) + c₂ (d.2 x))
                      ((fun x => LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_apply_apply c₁ x) (JFA.injectivePure 𝕜 E X f g))))
                  (Eq.mp
                    (congr
                      (congrArg Eq
                        ((fun x => LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply c₂ x) (T (c₁ (JFA.injectivePure 𝕜 E X f g)))))
                      (map_add c₂ (JFA.injectivePure 𝕜 F X (d.1 f) g) (d.2 (JFA.injectivePure 𝕜 E X f g))))
                    h)))
            h;
        Exists.intro (d.1, S)
          ⟨⟨hS, fun f g h hh p =>
              have hrep :=
                ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.ext fun q => Eq.trans (hh q) (Eq.symm (JFA.czeroTensorEquiv_pure f g q));
              Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (T _a) p = ⋯ * ⋯ + ⋯ p) hrep))
                (have h := congrArg (fun k => k p) (hproduct f g);
                have hc₂ := JFA.czeroTensorEquiv_pure (d.1 f) g p;
                Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => ⋯ p = _a + ⋯) hc₂) h)⟩,
            fun y =>
            Prod.casesOn (motive := fun x =>
              (fun d =>
                    JFA.HasSeparableRange 𝕜 ((M₁ × L) →C₀ 𝕜) ((M₂ × L) →C₀ 𝕜) d.2 ∧
                      ∀ (f : C(M₁, 𝕜)) (g : L →C₀ 𝕜) (h : (M₁ × L) →C₀ 𝕜),
                        (∀ (p : M₁ × L), h p = f p.1 * g p.2) → ∀ (p : M₂ × L), (T h) p = ⋯ * ⋯ + ⋯ p)
                  x →
                x = (d.1, S))
              y fun V R a =>
              And.casesOn a fun hR hVR =>
                let R' := (↑c₂.symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv).comp (R.comp ↑c₁.toContinuousLinearEquiv);
                have hR' :=
                  JFA.HasSeparableRange.comp_left (JFA.HasSeparableRange.comp_right hR ↑c₁.toContinuousLinearEquiv)
                    ↑c₂.symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv;
                have hVR' := fun f g =>
                  have heq := ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.ext ⋯;
                  have h := ⋯;
                  ⋯;
                have hd := hunique (V, R') ⟨hR', hVR'⟩;
                Prod.ext (congrArg (fun A => ⋯) hd) (ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun h => ⋯)⟩
